intro.title: How 30 days of SEO works
intro.startBody: Start records which pages are already on your site, using your sitemap or the URLs in Pages. When available, it also records your site’s Google Search clicks from the previous 30 days.
intro.workTitle: Build a steady SEO habit that never resets
intro.workBody: Opening this project checks in the day once. Worked on your SEO elsewhere? Mark that day yourself, within your 30 days. A missed day never resets your count.
intro.finishBody: After 30 calendar days, download your badge and create a report for exactly those days, however many you checked in.
intro.lead: Do some SEO on this project each day for 30 days. Opening the project checks in the day for you, and at the end you share what changed.

dayOneSteps.captureBody: bisibility saves the URLs from your sitemap, or the URLs in Pages if you have no sitemap. That gives the report a starting point for comparing existing and newly added pages. If Search Console data is available, bisibility also records your site’s clicks from the previous 30 days.
